description.narrative: Honduras - Transportation Project - Secondary Roads Activity: The upgrade of key secondary routes to improve the access of rural communities to markets. MCC Funding will fund the paving of up to 91 kilometers of key secondary routes with a "double treatment" of asphalt to improve velocity and reduce maintenance costs.

condition.narrative: 14. Continued compliance, satisfactory to MCC, with road-specific EMPs.
15. MCC is satisfied that MCA-H has completed the acquisition of rights of way for secondary roads to be constructed.
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
MCA-H complies with each resettlement plan, to the satisfaction of MCC.
MCA-H will have on file a report, acceptable to MCC, verifying that baseline data - to include relevant environmental baseline data as described in the EMP - has been gathered for that road.
MCC has approved the secondary roads that MCA-H has selected to be constructed/rehabilitated using MCC Funding.
The International Roughness Index is less than 2.0 m/km on the completed portions of Secondary roads improved by MCC funding (for the first six months and 3.0 thereafter) 1
